messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're going to change the internal policy-adapter to emit an `x-route-hints-v2` header. Need SDKs to surface it and Console to backfill older events. Plan to start next week; any blockers?
chris: Clarify the impact — is this a breaking change for clients that don't opt in? what's the fallback?
sam: From SDK perspective it's a small opt-in param. But if the server starts expecting it for better routing, missing headers will degrade routing quality (not immediate hard-fail). I can prep PRs for py/ts/go.
nidhi: Console: backfill is doable but we'll need to normalize raw request logs. If we synthesize v2 from inference traces we should tag those as synthetic so dashboards know.
maria: Exactly. Fallback: policy-adapter will infer route hints for ~2 weeks after rollout but inferred records must be marked `_synthetic_route_v2`. After the window we remove inference fallback.
sam: Draft SDK ergonomics: Python/TS will expose an optional `route_hints` param; Go will have `WithRouteHints(ctx, map[string]string)`. Example for Python:```python
client = Redwood(api_key=..., route_hints={"intent":"search","cost_center":"web"})
client.generate(...)
```
TS similar shape.
dev-bot: CI update — policy-adapter PR #3456 passed unit tests, integration tests failing on canary gate.
chris: Integration error from canary: ```
ERROR: missing header 'x-route-hints-v2' when expected
```
Is the test harness missing the new header?
sam: Yep — our client test harness didn't simulate injection. I'll add a compatibility shim to tests and open a hotfix branch.
nidhi: Backfill plan (console): run transform job in staging first, verify dashboards, then run in prod for last 30 days. We'll need ops approval for raw log access.
harry-ops: ops ok for access, prefer running backfill Tue 02:00 UTC in a maintenance window. Will throttle job.
maria: Timeline proposal: Mon — SDK PRs + docs; Tue — backfill dry-run in staging; Wed — adapter canary (20%); Thu — remove inference fallback for legacy if stable. Need clear owners for SDK releases and runbook.
sam: I'll own Python/TS SDK releases and the client-side logging. I'll add parsing logs for whether headers were present vs inferred. PRs: python#789 ts#456 go#102.
nidhi: I'll own console backfill and create a runbook that marks synthesized vs real. Also add a dashboard flag to filter.
maria: Also add a telemetry counter `route_v2_mismatch` to surface quality/regression alerts in Console Optimize.
dev-bot: Canary deployed to us-east-1 (20% traffic). Monitoring: slight uptick 500s ~0.2%.
chris: I'm seeing quota attribution anomalies from the canary — some requests are being attributed to the wrong cost centers when header parsing falls back. Might be a parsing edge-case.
maria: Hold further backfill until we confirm stability. Sam — can you add detailed parsing debug logs and a short-lived metric `route_v2_parse_error` so we can correlate? If anomalies persist revert the canary.
sam: On it. Pushing test + logging updates tonight. Will post links when ready.
harry-ops: Setting a 6-hour rollback timer for the canary; will execute if errors don't drop.
nidhi: Pausing production backfill until canary is green.
maria: Thanks all — I'll keep the rollout checklist pinned. Post PR links here and tag owners in release notes.
